description: Tarrif of Time of Use (ToU) Indian Power System is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors SAMARENDRA SINGH. I this dataset, different tarrif rate at corresponding time of use (ToU) are mentioned with nature of load profile like whether it is "Valley", "Flat" or "Peak". in Indian Power Grid System. Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
